milestone: X78.37 — Creator History Coverage & Completeness Contract

baseline.worktree: pre-existing dirty worktree preserved; X78.37 adds an opt-in conservative coverage ledger

current_coverage_audit.conclusion: address_scan_state is a scheduler marker, not a creator-history coverage cursor

termination_classification.provider_history_exhausted: A — provider exhaustion only; deep-page contiguity remains unproven without overlap

implementation.model: append-only runs and pages plus an explicit conservative current state
implementation.ordering: existing page facts commit before coverage observation; a crash can understate coverage but cannot overstate it

mutable_head_and_continuation.deep_page_cursor_stability: not proven by retained local evidence or provider contract
mutable_head_and_continuation.overlap_requirement: required before a deep multi-page range can be marked contiguous
mutable_head_and_continuation.duplicate_handling: recorded per durable page; duplicates never prove continuity

advancement_gate.reason: The ledger durably distinguishes complete/exhausted, unverified exhaustion, partial, failed and unknown states and can represent a proven boundary. Existing deep scans have no overlap proof, so they are intentionally not reusable yet.
